methods.name: DroidBot-GPT
methods.description: A two-step solution where when the LLM model chooses to edit in a text box, DroidBot-GPT sends another prompt asking what to enter into the view with the specified text content.

methods.name: prompt synthesis
methods.description: The prompt includes task representation, GUI elements with action choices, action history, and output requirement.

methods.name: GUI description translation
methods.description: Converts a graphical user interface into a natural language sentence for processing by GPT models.
